summary: Veritone filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 Other Events reporting that CEO Ryan Steelberg voluntarily reduced his salary by 50% from $665,000 to $332,500 effective July 14, 2026 to support the company's ongoing cost reduction initiatives amid a business realignment. No shareholder vote, transaction, or board recommendation is involved; there are no structural changes, acquisition terms, or regulatory deadlines. While a salary cut may signal financial pressure, it is not a special situation—it is an internal cost-saving measure, not a tender, restructuring, or management change event. The filing lacks any deal mechanics, premiums, or shareholder action items.
